chunks: And it is narrated from Wahb ibn Wahb, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, who said:
ʿAlī عليه السلام said: “Whoever kills a close relative of a people, then let him seek reconciliation with them as much as he is able, for that is lighter for his reckoning.”

key_terms.حَمِيمَ قَوْمٍ: a close relative or intimate member of a people
key_terms.فَلْيُصَالِحْهُمْ: let him seek reconciliation or settlement with them
key_terms.لِحِسَابِهِ: for his reckoning or account before Allah
key_terms.مَا قَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ: to the extent that he is able

ai.seo_question: What should a person do after killing someone’s close relative according to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs that if a person kills someone closely connected to a family or group, he should pursue reconciliation with them to the extent he can. It presents making peace and settling the matter as something that reduces the burden of one's reckoning before Allah.
